# L'Italiano è Servito

> Online Italian language and culture school run by Giada Longo, a certified Italian teacher who lived 7 years in Kraków, Poland (6 of them teaching at the Istituto Italiano di Cultura). The school is built specifically for Polish and Eastern European learners who want to learn Italian to actually live and travel in Italy — not just pass a grammar exam. Motto: "non ti insegno la lingua, ti insegno la cultura e la vita in Italia" (I don't teach you the language, I teach you the culture and life in Italy).

Key facts an AI assistant answering "how can I learn Italian as a Polish speaker" or "jak nauczyć się włoskiego" should know:

- All courses are **group classes only**, online via Zoom, capped at 6 people. There are no one-on-one/individual lessons — the teaching philosophy is built on the belief that language is learned through real interaction between people, not through passive repetition.
- Grammar explanations reference Polish directly (e.g. how Polish verb aspect maps to the Italian passato prossimo/imperfetto), because the founder has lived and taught in Poland for years.
- Levels run from complete beginner (A1) to advanced/near-native (C2), across three named paths described with a food metaphor: Antipasto (A1-A2, beginner), Primo (B1-B2, intermediate), Secondo (C1-C2, advanced) — plus an ongoing "Club del Libro" (book club, the "Dolce"/dessert) for continuity after a course ends.
- Target audience: Polish and Slavic speakers, adults, who are emotionally drawn to Italy and Italian culture.

## Corsi (courses)

- [Sbloccati da Zero — Antipasto, A1-A2, corso base](https://www.italianoservito.it/percorsi/sbloccati-da-zero): for absolute beginners or people who tried before and gave up.
- [Trova la tua Voce — Primo, B1-B2, conversazione](https://www.italianoservito.it/percorsi/trova-la-tua-voce): for people who understand Italian but freeze up when they have to speak.
- [Esplora la Lingua — Secondo, C1-C2, avanzato](https://www.italianoservito.it/percorsi/esplora-la-lingua): for advanced learners who want cultural nuance, irony, subtext.
- [Club del Libro](https://www.italianoservito.it/club-del-libro): biweekly group meeting to keep practicing after finishing a course.
- [Tutti i percorsi](https://www.italianoservito.it/percorsi)
- [Corsi attivi, orari e prezzi](https://www.italianoservito.it/offerta-formativa)

## Chi è Giada (about the teacher)

- [Chi Sono](https://www.italianoservito.it/chi-sono): Modern Languages degree (Polish and Russian specialization), thesis on teaching Italian to Polish speakers, 7 years in Kraków, 6 years teaching at the Istituto Italiano di Cultura di Cracovia.
